title: 0015 coalescing witness: undefined lane after identity-copy removal
attribution: Historical June 0015 contributor: agent/tool version, exact model ID/version, and reasoning effort unknown in the recovered records; earlier recorded credits are preserved in archived originals.
OpenAI Codex CLI 0.157.0 (codex-tui), model gpt-6-astra, xhigh reasoning effort: verified session metadata; witness recovery, isolated 0015/0028 comparison, stock-upstream replay, and documentation.
summary: The retained rcundef.c witness reproduces the historical undefined-rc3 signature on an identified current fork reconstructed without 0015 and 0028. Adding only existing patch 0028 repairs the same IR; 0015 is a trigger-avoidance workaround for this witness. Rewriter output differs only by three KILL pseudos, with identical register assignments. The existing eight-instruction model reproduces on saved unpatched upstream 742d554 using mos6502; stock C reachability remains unproven.
unknowns: The exact June failing binary and complete June build state were not recovered; the failing baseline here is an explicitly reconstructed current fork.
No naturally produced stock-upstream C witness was found in this bounded search. The eight-instruction stock MIR is a constructed model, not the unchanged output of automated reduction.
This establishes the cause of the retained 0015 C witness, not that every historical report sharing its diagnostic has the same cause.

resolution.causal_explanation: With 0015 absent in both builds, the comparison changes only VirtRegMap.cpp.o. Reverse-applying the current 0028 patch reproduces the baseline source exactly. Without 0028 the rewriter deletes a full identity COPY carrying an undef-lane definition; the following rc3 use has no physical definition. With 0028 the COPY remains as a KILL. Comparing rewritten MIR finds three KILL insertions and no allocation changes, disproving the claimed regmask-violating allocation mechanism for this recovered witness.
resolution.trigger_check: The same retained C-generated a16/Os LLVM IR is compiled at backend O2 with MachineVerifier in both runs; no frontend rewrite hides the trigger. A 2x2 matrix independently toggles 0015 and 0028. Plain-stock MIR validates before allocation and fails only after greedy/virtregrewriter.
resolution.disposition: Existing root fix 0028 is already installed. Keep historical guard and patch artifacts; do not submit 0015 as an independently established allocator repair. Guard removal is separate work.
